about_the_game:
Gameplay

  • A genre-bending "2nd-person" combat system, featuring a mix of highly mechanical shooter and melee gameplay

  • 3 days. 32 recruits. 1 story you will shape together.

  • High-intensity Souls-like boss fights

Story

300 Years Ago

The Tower was discovered during maritime exploration. Early human expeditions vanished without a trace, cementing its reputation as a place of mystery, danger, and legend.

50 Years Ago

With advances in AI, autonomous robots were deployed into the Tower to explore its depths. However, all attempts failed. Traditional wireless communication was disrupted inside the Tower, and no meaningful data was ever recovered, leaving its interior a complete unknown.

Present Day

Advancements in neutrino communication enabled the development of the Akasha System, allowing humans to remotely pilot SSFrames—mechanized bodies—into the Tower, accompanied by automata for support. These expeditions have uncovered extraordinary resources: plants that extend human lifespan, and vast, untapped energy sources. In response, the Tower Delver Association was founded to manage exploration and extract these valuable discoveries.

"Welcome Recruit"

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K | Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 7 1800X | AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650, 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 480, 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
